usage: The word 蟬 (sim4) refers to the insect cicada.
蟬 is usually used as a noun to name this specific insect.
You can use 蟬 in sentences to talk about nature or insects.
蟬 can appear in descriptions of summer sounds because of their loud calls.
The word 蟬 can also be used metaphorically in poetry or stories, but here we focus on its literal meaning.

examples.meaning: I hear cicadas singing on the tree.
